# `Q-2-47` — Cell option ignored on a diagram cell

> A diagram cell has no execution engine to pass unrecognized options
> to, so this option has no effect.

## What this means

A ```` ```mermaid ```` block can carry cell options, written after a
`%%|` marker at the top of the block:

```` markdown
```mermaid
%%| label: fig-review
%%| fig-cap: The review cycle.
flowchart LR
  Draft --> Review
```
````

Diagram cells accept exactly four: `label`, `fig-cap`, `fig-scap`, and
`fig-alt`. Anything else raises this warning, and the option is
dropped.

## Why this happens

The warning covers two different mistakes, and the message tells you
which one you have.

**The option is not one Quarto knows.** Usually an execution option
carried over from a code cell:

```` markdown
```mermaid
%%| echo: false
flowchart LR
  A --> B
```
````

`echo` is meaningful for a ```` ```{python} ```` cell because an engine
runs it and decides whether to show the source. A diagram is not
executed — the source is sent to the browser and drawn — so there is no
engine to interpret the option and nothing sensible for Quarto to do
with it.

This is also what you see for Quarto 1's `theme` and `mermaid-format`,
which Quarto 2 does not yet support.

**The option is a real Quarto option that does not apply here.** The
clearest case is `fig-scap` on a numbered diagram: a short caption has
somewhere to go on an unnumbered figure but not on a numbered float, so
it is reported rather than silently discarded.

## Why the warning is specific to diagrams

Executable cells are deliberately *not* warned about. There, an
unrecognized key is normally an engine option — `echo`, `eval`,
`warning`, or something engine-specific — that the engine reads
directly. Warning about those would fire on nearly every real document.

## How to fix

Delete the option. If it was doing something in a Quarto 1 document,
check whether Quarto 2 supports the feature yet — diagram sizing
(`fig-width`, `fig-height`), pre-rendered output (`mermaid-format`) and
theming are all listed as not-yet-available in the
[Diagrams guide](../../guides/authoring/diagrams.qmd).
